name: Retirement Plan Resource Group
_verticalNote: Wizard extraction had a whole sentence here ('employer-sponsored retirement plan education and consulting service.') — cleaned to a short tag. Not special-cased anywhere in the engine today (only 'dental'/'restaurant' are); toolsForVertical() falls through to DEFAULT_TOOLS (check_availability/book_appointment/save_contact) for this vertical, which is correct for a meeting-booking business.
_brandColorNote: Still the engine default placeholder — no real brand color/logo was captured during onboarding. Ask the client before go-live.
_agentsNote: receptionist (inbound line, for anyone who calls back) + calling (the actual product — outbound dialer working Aman's provided lead lists, per server/dialer.js) + librarian. Deliberately NOT leads: that agent polls Meta/Google Lead Ads, and this client's own two lead sources — a list Aman provides, and 'web scraping' — are neither of those; leads arrive via the Lead Engine's CSV import (Leads tab), not this agent. Deliberately NOT audit/billing (no clinical visits/claims here) or rfp-responder/signal-watcher (not mentioned in onboarding). Add leads back later if they ever want Meta/Google form capture. researcher added 2026-08-04 (dormantByDefault — shows in catalog, not auto-active) for company-enrichment on uploaded leads, per the client's own onboarding-adjacent ask to research the companies they upload; gated behind ENRICHMENT_ENABLED and a real BRAVE_API_KEY/SERPER_API_KEY, neither configured yet.
_tabsNote: Outbound calling + calendar-booked consultations, no orders.
